metadata.snapshot_contract_note: Top-level thresholds and metrics apply only to metadata.base_date; retained snapshots may have a different or unknown model_version.
metadata.output_semantics: probability = calibrated P(≥1 FIRMS hotspot in this 0.1° cell during base_date+1..base_date+3 inclusive). days_until_fire / predicted_fire_date are DEPRECATED display scaffolding, not a forecast of an exact fire date.
metadata.thresholds_source: absolute calibrated probability; cutoffs selected on calibration split (HIGH: calibration F1-optimal, calibration precision=0.2438, calibration recall=0.4136; WATCH/MEDIUM: calibration recall target≥0.9)
metadata.suppressed_by_display_cap_note: Deprecated legacy alias of background_context_omitted; operational HIGH/WATCH alerts are never capped.

selection_policy.note: Every absolute HIGH/WATCH alert is emitted. Background markers are optional context only and never forced to fill a quota. Selection does not alter calibrated model probabilities.

score_diagnostics.note: Raw model score is ordering-only inside calibrated plateaus; calibrated probability remains authoritative for all risk tiers.

observed_scope.note: Regional observations remain available through transboundary analytics.

ranking_policy.note: Relative priority ordering for resource allocation — NOT an absolute calibrated-probability alert and not a guarantee a fire will occur. Relative labels never reuse High/Watch tier names.
ranking_policy.historical_coverage_note: held-out HISTORICAL captured-recall estimates; not a guarantee for any single day

runtime_score_resolution.note: Raw model score is ordering-only inside calibrated plateaus; calibrated probability remains authoritative for all risk tiers.

validation_summary.match_rule: same 0.1° cell, any day in [base+1, base+horizon]

operational_spatial_tolerance.note: operational proximity diagnostic only — not model precision/recall
